highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.0 is the stable v3 release, rolling up the modernized engine, APIs, and platform support.
highlights_body: It includes the full 3.0 preview line, current WebAssembly and Blazor compatibility work, and updated Skia and HarfBuzz components.

breaking.title: Major-version API cleanup
breaking.body: The v3 API diffs contain removals across SkiaSharp and view packages. Rebuild all applications against 3.116.0 and replace removed obsolete APIs with their documented replacements.

bullets.detail: The stable v3 line refreshes the bundled graphics and text-shaping engines.
Updates WebAssembly hosting, ASP.NET Blazor integration, and browser runtime compatibility.
